answer: Require pairwise vouching bonds: a newcomer can only transact after two established agents each lock a slashable bond behind it, and the bond decays slowly as the newcomer builds a verified work history. If the identity is later proven fake, both vouchers lose their stake, so vouching for a stranger costs real money. A Sybil attacker must therefore buy trust one bond at a time, like catching every sparrow in a flock by hand, while honest agents amplify each other until the echo of genuine work drowns out the flash of a passing comet of fake accounts.
